solution_approach: I will row number trades partitioned by holding id from newest to oldest by trade date and trade id. I will keep row number 1 as the latest event.
schema: investors(investor_id PK, investor_name, city, segment, joined_date); securities(security_id PK, security_name, category, status, base_value); holdings(holding_id PK, investor_id FK, security_id FK, acquired_date, status, market_value); trades(trade_id PK, holding_id FK, trade_date, trade_type, quantity, amount, status)
learner_question: If a holding has multiple trades on its latest trade date, which one should be selected?
manager_reply: Pick the trade with the largest trade number on that latest date, and omit holdings without trades.
